CLI MINIMIZATION (2026-11-09, user decision): inventory-first — no two tools for one job, prefer basic tools, and prefer a CLI over file edits whenever a CLI exists (file edits stay only where no CLI exists — themes — and are minimized there). Applied: flatpak overrides via `flatpak override --show`+diff+flags (keyfile renderer deleted), passwords via `chpasswd -e` (direct shadow writer + lock deleted), disks via `mount`/`umount` (udisks2 dropped) and listing via sysfs+/proc/blkid/df (lsblk dropped), capability udisks2→parted. Kept with rationale: platform fallback pairs (useradd/adduser, usermod/addgroup/gpasswd, rc-*/dinitctl) are portability, not redundancy; five CUPS tools have distinct roles (lpadmin cannot replace cupsenable); btrbk+btrfs distinct (btrbk 0.32 has no restore); smartctl/mkfs unique. Excluded: systemd symlinks, firewalld/NM daemon-owned configs (their CLIs own them).

NO DBUS (2026-11-09, user decision after a Webmin study): Ursine never speaks D-Bus — no zbus, no gsettings/session-bus tools (invariant 3 in rules/ursine.md + AGENTS.md "Minimal components" workflow principle + overview Auth model). Webmin is the reference: direct /etc/passwd, /etc/shadow, /etc/group edits + system CLIs; a CLI may use D-Bus internally, that is its component. Applied: users module rewritten (passwd parse, useradd/userdel with BusyBox fallback, direct shadow write for passwords), bluetooth pairing agent + set_bluetooth_pairing_pin removed (bluetoothctl NoInputNoOutput), theming eog target + live gsettings button-layout removed (settings.ini is the source of truth), zbus dropped from Cargo, capability accountsservice→shadow (probes useradd/adduser) + Bluez/NetworkManager binary-only probes + Disks requires parted, Home shows the fix command on activated features, protocol v5. Dead code/files deleted (agent.rs, gsettings helpers). Excluded with rationale: system CLIs keep their own D-Bus (nmcli/bluetoothctl internals), FeralOS still ships accountsservice for greetd (we simply no longer call it).

CAPABILITY PROBES CLI-ONLY (2026-11-09, accepted trade-off): BlueZ and NetworkManager capabilities probe the CLI binary only (bluetoothctl/nmcli), NOT /run/dbus/system_bus_socket — the panel can show "available" while the system daemon is down, and actions then fail with their own error. Rationale (user rule): capabilities name the exact CLI the module runs; the socket is a D-Bus probe (invariant 3) and service liveness belongs to the action error path, not the capability.

UNIFORM BACKUP ROTATION (2026-11-07): ONE mechanism for every config file we write or change via CLI — slot naming <file>.ursine-backup[.N], rotation BEFORE the live replace, rotation failure aborts the write (shell exit 42). Count from [backup_configs] copies = 3 in /etc/ursine/config.toml (default 3, clamp 1..=10, restart to apply; the config file governs its own backups). CLI-changed files rotated before the CLI runs: crontab (previous content to /var/backups/ursine, fail-closed), nix registry JSON, flatpak repo/config, /etc/apk/world (add/del only), /etc/firewalld, NM system-connections, /etc/cups/printers.conf, account files (passwd/shadow/group/gshadow). dconf rotated ONCE per theming apply (not per target). EXCLUDED with rationale: nix profile generations (native rollback), flatpak/apk package DBs (transactional), systemd enable symlinks (reversible), audit JSONL (append-only). Legacy schemes (timestamped restore/scanner copies, dot-prefixed atomic slots, btrbk .conf.bak) pruned to the same cap.

NIX REPOSITORIES (2026-11-06): implemented as the NATIVE nix flake registry (nix registry list/add/remove as the acting user, ~/.config/nix/registry.json) instead of an ursine config table — keeps the daemon stateless (invariant 3) and lets bare search installables resolve via the searched flake (repo= param prefixes them). global entries are read-only in the GUI; remove_nix_repository is destructive. Also: RUST_MIN_STACK=16MiB is now required for tests (test thread stack vs growing Action enum) — set in CI + build-and-test guide.

BLUETOOTH PAIRING AGENT (2026-11-06, TASKS v2): PIN/passkey lives in daemon RAM only (static tokio RwLock, never logged, flag-only on the wire, stdin on the CLI per the secret rule); a zbus org.bluez.Agent1 at /org/ursine/bluetooth/agent1 is registered (KeyboardDisplay + SetDefaultAgent) lazily when a PIN is set; RequestConfirmation accepts when no PIN is set (visual verification) or the passkey matches, denies on mismatch; without a PIN the legacy `--agent NoInputNoOutput` pair path is kept so bluetoothctl never competes with our agent.

DISKS FORMAT/PARTITION (2026-11-06, TASKS v2 "behind explicit enablement"): destructive trio (format_disk, partition_create, partition_delete) gated by a new root config key `disks_format` (default false; file edit + ursined restart = the explicit opt-in), PLUS exact-device typed confirmation (confirm_device must equal device) PLUS --yes in the CLI. fstype whitelist (ext4/xfs/btrfs/vfat/exfat/f2fs/ntfs) before any mkfs path is built; partition sizes are explicit MiB start/end via parted. GUI shows nothing but an enablement note while the flag is off. Original SPEC "formatting out of scope" superseded by TASKS.

FIREWALL ENABLE/DISABLE (2026-11-06, TASKS v2 required vs original SPEC deferral): firewalld has no global on/off switch, so the toggle maps to the DEFAULT ZONE target - enabled=true sets REJECT, enabled=false sets ACCEPT (permanent + reload), status derives `enabled` from the default-zone target != ACCEPT and the GUI labels it "Filtering" with a disable confirmation; ursinectl treats enabled=false and delete_firewall_service as destructive. Round-trip note: a zone that used DROP becomes REJECT after one cycle (both block; documented). Zone create/delete NOT implemented (not in plan lines: zone management = default zone + per-zone rules, already shipped).

FLATPAK PERMISSIONS EDITOR (2026-11-04): edits the override keyfile directly instead of `flatpak override --reset` (reset deletes [Session Bus Policy]); four owned lists only, everything else preserved verbatim; GLib key/escape handling (trimmed keys around =, env values decode/encode \n \t \r \\); SET serialized by in-process mutex, residual cross-process TOCTOU documented; backup is dot-prefixed (. <basename>.ursine-backup) so it can never collide with flatpaks filename->app-id mapping. as_user: only explicit system=false (and remotes system=false) honor a target; non-root own-account only.

OPENCODE V2 (2026-11-04): agent pack fully on V2 shapes (plugins/permissions/agents config; permissions-array frontmatter; subagent commands; no temperature/hidden). opencode-rules 2.0.0 is V2-native. Agent switching = Shift+Tab (agent.cycle) + Ctrl+X a (agent.list); subagents via Task/slash commands, not Tab. doom_loop dropped (not a V2 action). Per-agent permission copies live in frontmatter only (config entries are {}).

CRONTAB VIA -u (2026-11-02): crontab operations use `crontab -u <user>` root-direct — no su impersonation, no suid dependency (user directive). Impersonation kept only where unavoidable: nix profile ops (getuid-based per-user state), flatpak --user (per-user installation ownership), niri config I/O (review decision: root never opens user paths), theming gsettings (user session D-Bus), scanimage (user device visibility).
